title: The.xvij. Chapter. Whether God be the Author of ſinne; out of the ſecond booke of Sam. the 16. chapter, verſe 22. Looke in Iud. 3, 9. and 9, 24. and 2. Sam, 2, 27. and 1. Kings. 22, 21. and In Rom. 1.

segments.text:
¶ I knowe I am miſreported, that I make God to be the author of ſinne; but that is not true, as it ſhall plainlie appeare. But I onlie indeuour by my doctrine, to ſhew how the ſcriptures must be vnderſtood, when they ſeeme ſo to affirme: Alſo what
Auguſtine ment, who ſaid, that God bendeth the wils of men aſwell vnto good, as vnto euill: And in like maner, how Zuinglius & Oecolampadius, and other great learned men, profeſſors of the Goſpell, must be vnderstood, when they ſeeme to auouch the ſame.
